free_tier.stated: Scale as you go from $5 USD / month. Deploy your applications in minutes. Free trial is available.

egress.free_allowance: No free application tier. External bandwidth is $0.1 per GB on the H1 $5/month pod.

interface_detail: Networking tab in the application dashboard.
tooling: Dashboard only for proxy creation; deployments by git push or Docker image.
chaining: A paid Sevalla app with a TCP proxy could carry SSH; no free path.

limits.value: external bandwidth $0.1/GB; no free app tier

binding_note: There is no free application tier at all: the smallest app is $5/month and 1 TiB of external bandwidth would be $102.40 on top.

identity_cost.detail: Account signup; the free trial is time-limited, and the cheapest app is H1 at $5/month.

reliability_note: Legacy TCP proxy endpoints disabled 2026-10-15; clients had to be repointed to the new hostname.
confidence_note: Reading the trial terms would fix the exact length; it would not change the verdict.

evidence.proved: "Protocol | TCP"; 3 TCP proxies per application; port from 20000-29999 or 32768-65000

notes: Free tier exists only for static sites (100 GB bandwidth), which is not a port. Legacy TCP proxy hostnames and ports were disabled on Oct 15, 2026, so an existing .proxy.sevalla.app address stopped working.

extras.wg_detail: TCP proxies only: "Protocol | TCP. Use TLS in your own protocol if the traffic needs encryption." Port assigned from 20000-29999 or 32768-65000.
